source: while false; do echo NEVER; done
until true; do echo NEVER; done
N=aaa; while test -n "$N"; do echo "$N"; N=${N#a}; done
N=aaa; until test -z "$N"; do echo "$N"; N=${N#a}; done
N=a; while test -n "$N"; do N=; false; done
N=a; until test -z "$N"; do N=; false; done
false; while false; do :; done; echo $?
! while false; do :; done
! until true; do :; done
N=a; until ! test -n "$N"; do echo "$N"; N=; done
N=a; while test -n "$N"; do echo "$?"; N=; done
N=a; until test -z "$N"; do echo "$?"; N=; done
false; while printf "%s\n" "$?"; false; do :; done
N=a; while test -n "$N"; do N=; false; done; echo $?
N=aa; while printf "c%s\n" "$N"; test -n "$N"; do N=${N#a}; printf "b%s\n" "$N"; done
N=keep; true || while true; do N=bad; done; echo "$N"
N=keep; false && until false; do N=bad; done; echo "$N"
N=aa; while test -n "$N" && true; do echo "$N"; N=${N#a}; done
if true; then :; fi; while false; do :; done
N=aaaaaaaaaaaa; while test -n "$N"; do printf x; N=${N#a}; done
